# Intent: <change or project name>

Use only when the existing product plan, roadmap or feature specification lacks equivalent intent. Record existing explicit authorization; this template does not require the owner to repeat an approval.

**Status:** draft | approved | superseded

**Owner:** <name>

**Date:** YYYY-MM-DD

## Outcome

What should be true when this work is complete? Write the result in human terms.

## Why now

What problem, opportunity, or decision motivates the work?

## Scope

What is included in this increment?

## Non-goals

What is explicitly outside this increment?

## Affected systems and people

List only systems, repositories, data classes, and stakeholders materially affected.

## Constraints and safety boundaries

Include privacy, budget, reliability, compatibility, permission, and external-action limits. State whether an external write, deployment, message, or connection requires a separate approval.

## Acceptance checks

How will the owner know this is complete and safe enough for the intended use?

## Open questions

What must be answered before implementation or before a consequential action?

## Approval

- [ ] Record the owner instruction authorizing this scope; identify any remaining action-specific approval.
- [ ] Approval is not inferred from a model-generated draft.
